description: This file defines a React custom hook 'useAuth' that manages authentication state using the Supabase client. It provides functions for email/password sign-in, sign-up, Google OAuth sign-in, and sign-out, along with handling session updates and user profile management.

methods.name: useAuth()
methods.description: React hook providing authentication state and functions using Supabase.

methods.name: signInWithEmail
methods.description: Signs in a user with email and password.

methods.name: signUpWithEmail
methods.description: Registers a new user with email and password, redirecting email verification.

methods.name: signInWithGoogle
methods.description: Initiates OAuth sign-in with Google provider.
